title: Microcerts & Quickstarts: Onramp Accelerator Initiative
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Purpose: Reduce time-to-first-success for new developers integrating Redwood SDKs by shipping a compact program of microcerts (short guided tutorials) and language-specific quickstarts. This initiative combines product-authored quickstarts, CI-backed sample apps, and lightweight learning checkpoints (microcerts) that unlock repeatable remixable templates for common use cases (chat, embeddings, reranking). Goals: 1) Provide 10 fully working quickstarts across JS/TS, Python, and Go; 2) Add microcert assessments embedded in docs to measure comprehension; 3) Instrument funnel events to measure activation and iterate on high-friction steps. This ticket tracks cross-functional work, dependencies, and measurable outcomes for the onramp accelerator program.
acceptance_criteria: 10 language-specific quickstarts published in docs with runnable sample apps and CI that pass on merge
Microcert assessment flow embedded in 6 quickstarts with automatic grading and badge issuance
Analytics pipeline emits SDK first-call, quickstart-run, and badge-earned events to Amplitude/Mixpanel
Contributor guide and PR template for sample apps documented in the repo
Measureable lift: 15% improvement in time-to-first-API-call and 10% uplift in first-week retention for users who complete a quickstart
